answer: In the Skip-gram objective, the model predicts surrounding context words from a given center word. In the language-modeling objective, the model predicts the next word (or more generally the target word sequence) from the preceding context words. So Skip-gram goes from one word to its neighbors, while language modeling goes from context to the next token/word.
